description: One streamed Anthropic message with text and a tool call, traced by OpenInference.
notes: OpenInference records message content by default, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits the text and the tool arguments into 4 chunks each. Anthropic streams include usage without a separate request flag. The span has no timing attribute and no first-token event. Prompt 40 and completion 18 are copied. llm.finish_reason is tool_use on the span. The tool call is stored both as a content part and as tool_calls.
